args.content:
Hawaii Packing List

Based on your vacation itinerary (June 10-20, 2024), here's your complete packing list:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets for beach days and water activities)
- Sunscreen (high SPF for tropical sun protection)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head and other trails)
- Casual outfits (for shopping, dining, and relaxation)
- Camera (to capture memories of your Hawaiian adventure)
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, reservations)

Activity-Specific Items:
- Beach day at Waikiki Beach: Beach towel, flip flops, sunglasses
- Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay: Snorkel gear (or rent there), water shoes
- Hiking at Diamond Head: Hiking boots, water bottle, hat
- Pearl Harbor visit: Comfortable walking shoes, respectful attire
- North Shore road trip: Light jacket, snacks, music playlist
- Polynesian Cultural Center Luau: Camera, light evening wear
- Hotel spa day: Robe, slippers (usually provided)
- Kayaking at Kailua Beach: Quick-dry clothes, waterproof bag
- Shopping at Ala Moana Center: Comfortable shoes, extra luggage space

Additional Recommendations:
- Insect repellent
- Aloe vera gel (in case of sunburn)
- Reusable water bottle
- Light rain jacket (for tropical showers)
- Phone charger and waterproof case
- Cash and credit cards
- Medications and first aid kit
